The '''FT-5A Honor Guard''' was a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[FT-series]] produced by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The FT-5A later received a redesign that resulted in the [[FT-8 Star Guard]] model.<ref name="GS" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1stm}}
